newsitem.title: USA: Musicland to take Q4 charge, close 18 stores.
newsitem.headline: Musicland to take Q4 charge, close 18 stores.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Tuesday it would post an unspecified restructuring charge in the fourth quarter and would close 18 Media Play stores shortly after the first of the year.
The 18 store closings are in addition to 11 other Media Play closings earlier this year, bringing the division's total closings to 29 since last January.

Jack Eugster, chairman and chief executive, said because the inventory investment recovered from closing these stores would exceed closing costs, the closings would generate cash and eliminate stores that lost money in 1996.
